verdict.stance: Constructive / Rapidly Scaling Pan-European Fiber & Mobile Challenger (BB / BB+ Sr Sec)
verdict.summary: Digi Communications delivered 9M26 revenue of €1.8bn (+11% YoY) and Adj EBITDA (ex-leases) of €528m (+21% YoY) on dominant Romanian fiber/mobile cash flows and rapid Spanish/Portuguese subscriber growth. Net debt stands at ~€1.8bn (company net leverage improved to 2.7x), while €600m 4.625% 2031 notes (BB+ / RR3) fund capex rollouts.

positives: Strong +21% YoY Adj EBITDA growth in 9M26 (€528m) driven by Romania market leadership and Spain scale-up.
Company-reported net leverage improved to 2.7x at 30-Sep-26 with €600m 2031 senior secured refinancing.
Senior secured notes rated BB+ / RR3 (one notch above Fitch BB IDR) on strong asset coverage.
negatives: Elevated network rollout capex (Q326 alone €207m; FY25 FOCF -€337m) delays consolidated positive FCF.
Portuguese startup losses and competitive mobile pricing in Spain require ongoing capex.
Founder control (RCS Management) with multi-jurisdiction subsidiary structure.

background.business_overview: Leading Romanian telecom operator expanding aggressively in Spain, Portugal, and Belgium.
background.asset_perimeter: FTTH fiber and 4G/5G mobile networks in Romania and Spain, greenfield networks in Portugal.
background.ownership_governance: Controlled by Zoltan Teszari (RCS Management), listed on Bucharest Stock Exchange (DIGI).

recent_drivers: 9M26: Revenue €1.8bn (+11% YoY), Adj EBITDA ex-leases €528m (+21% YoY), net debt €1.8bn (2.7x co. leverage).
2031 Notes: Upsized €600m 4.625% Senior Secured Notes due 2031 (XS3216614084) rated BB+/RR3 by Fitch.
